title: Co-Branded Card Discount on Summit Top-Up Miles
content:
Holders of the Crestline co-branded card receive a percentage discount on a Crestline Summit Loyalty Program top-up purchase. The card is shown by the companion certificate issued on a card anniversary, as its record under the Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes charter shows it.

1. A Crestline Companion Certificate First or Premium Economy issued within the last 12 months gives 10 percent.
2. A Crestline Companion Certificate Main Cabin or Main Plus issued within the last 12 months gives 5 percent.
3. A member with no such certificate issued in that span gets no card discount.

"Within the last 12 months" means fewer than 12 whole calendar months from the certificate's issue date to the day of the purchase; a certificate issued on 30 April 2025 is inside the span on 29 April 2026 and outside it on 30 April 2026.

**How it applies.** The percent is taken of the price of the purchase, which is the miles bought, in thousands, multiplied by the net price per thousand. It is added to every other percentage discount on the purchase and taken off the price once, before the price is rounded to the cent.

**Hypothetical figure.** A purchase priced at 490.00 USD before percentage discounts, with a 10 percent card discount and no other percentage discount, costs 441.00 USD.
